module: Flowgraph node "Setup Pursuit Gameplay" (once_instant). Configures pursuit gameplay via gameplay_police.setupPursuitGameplay(suspectId, policeIds, {pursuitMode, preventAutoStart}). suspectId defaults to the player vehicle; mainPoliceId (if provided) replaces the policeIds list. Outputs success/fail. On success, marks the suspect and police as ignoreForceTeleport so that traffic "scatter" does not teleport them.
notes: If policeIds is nil (no pin connected) and the setup succeeds, `ipairs(policeIds)` raises a Lua error.

workOnce.desc: Starts the pursuit setup, writes success/fail and sets ignoreForceTeleport on the vehicles concerned.
